messages:
Sam (sales): Quick: FinTrust POC asks — Private VPC deploy but all egress must go through their on-prem inspection proxy and they require a static source IP for firewall allowlist. They also want pricing guidance (POC: reserved vs pay-as-you-go) and security q's on KMS/audit/token storage. Any preferred pattern?

Devon (SE): Recommend interface endpoints (PrivateLink) into their VPC for control plane & runtime + customer-managed NAT/EIP for egress. That gives them a stable outbound IP. Important: confirm if they will MITM TLS (TLS inspection) because that changes cert flow and SNI expectations.

Alex (NetEng): Two practical options:
- Option 1 (preferred): PrivateLink (interface endpoints) -> their TGW/transit -> on-prem proxy. Keeps traffic AWS-internal, customer retains egress IP (NAT EIP) for allowlisting. Minimal change to our infra.
- Option 2: VPC peering to our VPC and SNAT on their firewall or our side. Works but messy for multi-account and not ideal for strict isolation customers.

Alex (NetEng): For FinTrust pick Option 1. Easier to audit and they control the static IP.

Lina (SecE): Security checklist they asked about: CMK support, audit log retention (they want 7y), region constraints (they said us-east-1), where tokens live. We'll need to confirm if CMKs must be customer keys in their account or just KMS keys we manage.

Sam (sales): They want customer-managed CMKs + 7 years for logs. Confirm where API tokens are stored — do we encrypt with customer KMS?

Devon (SE): We store tokens in our control-plane vault encrypted with our KMS by default. For Private deployments we can integrate with customer-managed KMS (cross-account grant + role). I'll sketch the steps for KMS integration.

Alex (NetEng): Minimal netops handoff checklist to send them: 1) Create interface endpoints for com.redwood.inference.controlplane and com.redwood.inference-runtime (provide exact service names). 2) Ensure endpoint subnets route to TGW -> onprem for inspected egress. 3) Security group on endpoints allow 443 from their application subnets. 4) Provide their netops our service SANs and any callback IP ranges (if we ever call back).

Sam (sales): Can you paste a small firewall ACL snippet to give their netops?

Alex (NetEng): Sure, send this example (they can swap CIDRs):

-----
# Firewall rules (example)
- src: 10.0.0.0/16   # customer app subnets
- dst: <interface-endpoint-eni-cidr>   # interface endpoint ENIs in their account
- proto: TCP
- ports: 443
- action: allow
- description: Allow outbound HTTPS to Redwood Private endpoints
-----

Devon (SE): Pricing quick notes for sales:
- Hosted (metered): no infra commit, pay-per-token — cheapest for low-volume POC demos but less predictable latency.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): monthly commit, better predictable latency and lower per-token at scale — offer small 30-day eval pool for demos.
- Private (VPC/onprem): enterprise license + infra + support; includes integration effort for KMS/audit forwarding. Usually needs legal/contract.

Sam (sales): FinTrust wants consistent latency for demos but is budget conscious. Suggest proposing a 30-day small Dedicated eval (discounted) and fall back to hosted credits if they prefer no commit.

Devon (SE): Agree — we can offer a 30-day dedicated eval (e.g., 2-GPU equivalent pool) with short commit. I'll coordinate pricing and legal.

Lina (SecE): For the security questionnaire answer stub: "We store API tokens encrypted at rest in the control plane vault. For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (cross-account grants). All access is RBAC-gated and auditable via CloudTrail/VPCFlow logs; logs can be exported to customer SIEM and retained per contractual agreement (we can support 7 years retention)." I'll draft the formal one-pager.

DeployBot: Ticket SF-8242 created: "FinTrust POC - Privatelink + onprem inspection + pricing". Assigned to Devon (SE). ETA 2 business days.

Sam (sales): Next steps: @Devon prepare quote incl 30-day dedicated eval; @Alex prepare netops handoff doc + exact interface endpoint service names and SANs; @Lina prepare security one-pager + KMS steps. I'll schedule a 30-minute call with FinTrust netops for Thursday. :calendar: :thumbsup:
